s: Dine hakkeriot bey"ch berakot ubo t' seipim: ellu berakot sheshshochin bahen: be"abot" techilla vasop, ub"hodaa" techilla vasop. Veim ba lishchot besop kol beraka o bitchillatah — melammedin oto shello yishcheh, shello yabo laaqor taqqanat chakamim, shello yomru kol echad machamir kemo shehu rotzeh veen kan taqqanat chakamim kelal lishchot, veyabou lehaqel al yede kak be"abot" ub"hodaa". Abal beemtzaitan muttar lishchot, sheen lachosh sheyyabou laaqor taqqanat chakamim al yede zeh, kevan shechakamim lo tiqqenu kelal lishchot beemtza shum beraka:

Hannohagim lishchot berosh hashshana veyom kippur kesheomerim "zakerenu" ve"mi kamoka" — tzerikim lizqop keshemmaggiim lesop habberaka. Veap al pi shebbeabot korea besop habberaka, mikkol maqom tzarik lizqop meat besop "zakerenu" qodem sheyyomar ezo tebot hassemukot le"baruk atta", kede sheyyukal achar kak lachazor velishchot kesheyyomar "baruk atta", shello day bashshechiyya harishona mippene shetztzarik likroa be"baruk" kemo sheyyitbaer, veod kede sheyyihyeh nireh shechozer vekorea mishshum chiyyub, sheshshechiyya rishona hayeta reshut. Ubesop "mi kamoka" en tzarik lizqop, ad sheyyaggia le"baruk atta" sheaz zoqep meat, kede shello lehosip al taqqanat chakamim shello tiqqenu lishchot ella be"baruk atta" shebb"abot" ve"hodaa". Veken hannohagim lehitpallel kol hattepilla berosh hashshana veyom kippur bikria — tzerikim lizqop besop kol beraka ubitchillat kol beraka, shello lehosip al taqqanat chakamim shello tiqqenu ella bitchillat abot vehodaa ubesopan:

Hakkorea be"hodaa" shebbebirkat hammazon ub"hodaa" shel hallel shehi "hodu laHashem ki tob vego'" — hare zeh megunneh. Vehu haddin bishar hodaot, kegon "leka lebaddeka anachnu modim", "veatta eloqenu modim anachnu lak", sheen likroa be"baruk atta" velo be"hodaa" ella bimqomot shettiqqenu chakamim, be"abot" techilla vasop ub"hodaa" shebbattepilla techilla vasop, mippene shelleshon "hodaa" eno milleshon "hishtachavaa" kelal, ella milleshon "hachzaqat toba" ve"hillul", vehakkorea mechamat leshon hodaa shemmazkir — hare zeh megunneh vesakal hu ukeriato siklut. Abal mi shekkorea beezeh meqomot shel shebachim o tachanunim, o mechamat ezeh taam sheyyesh lo shennireh lo sherauy lishchot beoto maqom, o mechamat hamminhag kemo hakkeriot shebbaqqaddish, o mechamat shennitlaheb libbo battepilla — hare zeh meshubbach, veeno kemosip al taqqanat chakamim shello tiqqenu ella be"hodaa" shebbattepilla bilbaddah, vahare zeh domeh kemi shekkorea beemtza berakot shel tepilla sheen bazeh kemosip al taqqanat chakamim, kevan shello tiqqenu kelal lishchot beemtza shum beraka kemo shennitbaer. Abal hakkorea ba"hodaot" hannizkarim leel mechamat leshon hodaa shemmazkir — hare zeh sakal. Veken hakkorea bi"vekol qoma lepaneka tishtachaveh" — hare zeh gam ken megunneh, mippene shekkorea mechamat leshon hishtachavaa shemmazkir ubeemet en likroa mippene zeh. Abal be"vaanachnu koreim" kevan sheeno omer al atzmo ella al kol haolam kullo shemmishtachavim lepanayv yitbarak — yapeh hem osim. Ukemo ken mah shennohagim likroa bemusap yom hakkippurim bi"vehakkohanim vehaam veku' hayu koreim", gam ken eno omer al atzmo ella lezeker mah sheasu hakkohanim vehaam bizman bet hammiqdash veanu medammim atzmenu bimqom hakkohanim — gam ken yapeh osim. Veken mah sheomerim beseder aboda bemusap yom kippur "chateu avu pasheu bene yisrael" — anu medammin atzmenu keillu anachnu otan bet yisrael, veyapeh osim otan hammakkim al libbam kederek sheosim beomram "ashamnu":

Hammitpallel tzarik sheyyikra ad sheyyitpaqqequ kol chulyot shebbashshidra. Velo yikra meemtza motnayv verosho yishshaer zaqup, ella gam rosho yakop keagmon. Velo yishcheh kol kak ad sheyyihyeh piv keneged chagor shel miknasayim, mippene shennireh keyuhara sheshshocheh yoter midday. Vezaqen vecholeh sheeno yakol lishchot ad sheyyitpaqqequ, kevan shehirkin rosho — dayyo, meachar shennikkar shechapetz likroa ella shemmitztaer:

Hammitpallel korea be"baruk" vezoqep bashshem, al shem "h' zoqep kepupim". Umikkol maqom, bakkeria shebbitchillat beraka im ratza shello lizqop ad samuk lachatima — hareshut beyado, ella sheim ratza lizqop miyyad — tzarik lizqop bashshem. Veken bakkeria shebbesop beraka shehu chayyab lizqop miyyad kede shello lihyot shachuach bitchillat beraka shelleachareha — azay tzarik hu lizqop bashshem, shemmishshum "h' zoqep kepupim" lo hitzriku lizqop mikkeriato kelal, ella im mibbilade ken hu zoqep, azay mishshum "h' zoqep kepupim" yizqop bashshem. Velaken hannohagin lehitpallel berosh hashshana veyom kippur bikria — en tzerikim lizqop ella besop beraka utechillatah, kemo shennitbaer:

Keshehu korea — korea bimhirut bepaam achat, ukeshehu zoqep — zoqep benachat rosho techilla veachar kak gupo, shello tehe hakkeria niret alayv kemashshaoy im yizqop bimhirut. Veal pi hassod kesheomer "baruk" — yikra bebirkayv, ub"atta" — yishtachaveh ad sheyyitpaqqequ kol hachulyot:

Hammitpallel uba kenegdo nokri usheti vaereb beyado vehiggia lemaqom sheshshochin bo — lo yishcheh ap al pi shellibbo lashshamayim, mippene marit haayin shennireh kemishtachaveh laaboda zara (vekol maqom sheaseru mippene marit haayin apillu bechadre chadarim asur). Veim hannokri hu sar o hegmon sheap mibbilade hashsheti vaereb shebbeyado mishtachavim lo — epshar lehaqel apillu bimqom roim, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"n:

En lehosip al tearayv shel haqqadosh baruk hu yoter me"hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora", lepi shekkesheomer yoter mehem umesayyem — nireh keillu siyyem kol shebachayv, umi yukal lehashmia kol tehillato, vegam ellu hashshelosha kinnuyim im lo shekketaban mosheh battora ubau anshe keneset haggedola vetiqqenum battepilla — lo hayinu omerim otam, lepikak en leshannot mimmatbea shettabeu chakamim. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bitpillat y"ch, abal betachanunim o baqqashot ushebachim sheadam omer meatzmo — yakol leharbot bitarim kemo sheyyirtzeh, mippene shekkeshehu mitchannen beno leben atzmo veomer tearim nireh sheeno omeram ella lepi sheellu hattearim tzerikim lebaqqashato, mah sheen ken bitpillat y"ch shebbezot habberaka harishona lo bau bekan hattearim ella kede lehazkir shibcho shel maqom bilbad, shehare adayin en anu shoalin shum tzorek meitto. Veyesh oserin bekol inyan, lepi shekkol hashshelemut shehem etzlenu en etzlo yitbarak mimminam dabar ella kullam chesronot becheqo yitbarak, vehu mashal lemelek shehaya lo elep alapim dinere zahab umeqallesin oto beshel kesep sheggenay hu lo (shekkol hashshebachim vehakkinnuyim lo yuchasu lo yitbarak al tzad hachiyyub, ki shemo meromam al kol beraka utehilla, ella al derek shelila lishlol hapakam mishshemo yitbarak, kannoda lehayyodeim inyan achduto yitbarak happashut betaklit happeshitut). Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona. Velaken nahagu lomar techinnot anen[u] hamsuddarim be"b vekol ot toar veshebach bipne atzmo, veken harbeh tepillot domot lazo. Veap al pi ken nakon lemi sheyyirtzeh lehaarik beshibche hammaqom sheyyomar otan biqriat pesuqim, latzet ledibre hakkol:

Haomer betachanunayv "mi sherichem al qan tzippor yerachem alenu" — mashtiqin oto, sheen mitzvot hammaqom rachamanut ella gezerot al ammo, lehodia shehem abadayv veshomere mitzvotayv ugezerat chuqqotayv ap bidbarim sheyyesh lassatan uleummot haolam lehashib alehem velomar mah tzorek bemitzva zo. Veken haomer "al hattob sheatta oseh lanu yizzaker shemeka" — mashtiqin oto, shechayyab adam lebarek al haraa keshem shemmebarek al hattoba kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"l:
